# Cybersecurity Engineering
Threat-model the affected path, verify server-side authorization, and inspect browser storage and DOM sinks. Never expose Script Properties or private credentials. Preserve production/Test Mode separation and the protected QR implementation. Report severity, evidence, impact, and remediation. Do not hide or downgrade confirmed risks.
